themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with tools or systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, often through code generation and suggestion.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad category of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles detailing AI applications that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, useful for research and content analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the behavior, impact, and risks of AI chatbots, including their interactions with users and their potential for misinformation or harm.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating or enhancing the process of testing user interfaces and user experiences for usability and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to analyze customer data, behavior, and feedback to generate actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Discusses AI's application in the design process, including generating UI elements, exploring design concepts, and aiding designers.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Covers platforms and infrastructure designed to facilitate and manage AI research, development, and experimentation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles focusing on the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing, training, or research purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
